column1: # BabelSoft Script Data: Tibetan Extended Wylie transliteration tables
#   One block per table; the line after [name] names that block's columns, and
#   every value is the Tibetan text the key produces.  '-' means "nothing", and
#   the Wylie key is quoted only when a bare key would be ambiguous: "" is the
#   empty sequence (no prefix/superfix/vowel/final), " " is the Tsheg and "#"
#   initial      stem is the syllable's base letter; prefix-superfix holds the
#                prefix (ག ད བ མ འ) and superfix (ར ལ ས) letters carried by the
#                key; subfixes holds the subjoined letters (ྭ ྱ ྲ ླ, at most
#                two, in that order) — the three together drive the
#   subjoin      the subjoined letter as a standalone character.
#   medial       the a-chung (ཱ) and/or vowel sign.
#   final        the final letters (up to four).
